decision: Record closing observations and compare decimal odds only for the same market, side, line, book, and rules.

decision: Show frozen primary assessments and actual bets as separate journal summaries with counts and denominators.

decision: Validate a version 1 journal backup before any write and reject conflicts instead of replacing history.
